scripts.dev:up: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/.env -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml -f infrastructure/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.dev:up:build: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/.env -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml -f infrastructure/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.dev: npm run quality:fix && npm run dev:up
scripts.dev:build: npm run quality:fix && npm run dev:up:build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.quality:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format
scripts.ci: npm run quality && npm run test
scripts.security:audit: npm --prefix backend run security:audit && npm --prefix frontend run security:audit
